blind.description: A stylized wooden baby cradle with curved rocker runners on the bottom. It features a raised, hooded headboard with a small decorative cutout, a matching lower footboard, wooden plank sideboards, a light grey or white pillow, and a burgundy and brown checkered quilt or mattress inside. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and stylized with hand-painted style wood grain, with no floating fragments, holes, or untextured patches.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with extended rocker tips at the four corners, a thick arched headboard on the right, a small exposed strip of white pillow, and a grid-patterned reddish-brown quilt filling the rest of the interior.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (reaching roughly hip height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 to 3.5 feet long.
